fields.name: dyeColorCategoryID
documentation: What category of dye colors this slot is for; This currently has no functional useage as slots accept colors of any category, but may be used for things like labeling in the future

fields.name: channel
documentation: The specific shader channel that this slot affects when a dye color is applied

fields.name: dyeColorID
documentation: What dye color (if any) is currently applied to this slot

fields.name: dyeColorName
documentation: The name of the dye color (if any) that is currently applied to this slot

tables.name: HousingDecorInstanceInfo
documentation: Info for an instance of Housing Decor that has been/is being placed within a House or its exterior Plot

fields.name: isLocked
documentation: True if this decor is already being edited by someone else

fields.name: canBeCustomized
documentation: True if this decor can be customized, namely by applying Dyes

fields.name: canBeRemoved
documentation: False if this decor must remain placed in the house and cannot be placed back into house chest storage

fields.name: dyeSlots
documentation: Empty for decor that can't be dyed (see canBeCustomized)

fields.name: dataTagsByID
documentation: Simple localized 'tag' strings that are primarily used for things like categorization and filtering
